subject: Action required: manual PO activation blocked for Orchidea Supplies
messages:
From: Sarah Cole <sarah@orchidea-supplies.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@orchidea-supplies.com
Date: 2026-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Manual PO activation still greyed out - Orchidea

Hi Maya,

We uploaded the completed onboarding_form.pdf and attached a screenshot showing the portal state (bank-screenshot.png). The Zip supplier portal shows our vendor status as 'Pending verification' and the 'Activate manual PO' button is greyed out. Our procurement team needs this PO created today to avoid delaying shipments.

We tried:
- Re-uploading the form (no change)
- Clearing browser cache and trying incognito (same result)
- Using an alternate admin account (button still disabled)

Can you advise a workaround so we can get a temporary PO in the meantime? If you need any tenant or vendor ids, they are: Orchidea / V-7921.

Thanks,
Sarah Cole
Head of Procurement
Orchidea Supplies

Attachments: onboarding_form.pdf, bank-screenshot.png

From: maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Cole <sarah@orchidea-supplies.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-29T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Manual PO activation still greyed out - Orchidea

Hi Sarah — thanks for the details and the screenshot. Sorry you're blocked. I copied Ben (platform) and Laura (operations) to help triage.

Quick clarifying Qs:
- Can you confirm the exact vendor id as shown on your profile page (you listed V-7921; is that the one under Company > Vendor ID)?
- Are there any outstanding validation warnings on the profile page beyond the bank verification flag?

Proposed immediate workaround while we investigate:
1) We can create a one-time placeholder PO on our side and route approvals externally if you can confirm the exact PO line items and total. This will give your finance team a document to work against while we fix the portal claim flow.
2) Alternatively, Ben can try resending an admin activation link from the admin console (sometimes the activation token rebind fails and the UI greys out the manual action).

Ben / Laura — can you check logs for tenant Orchidea / V-7921 and see whether the manual PO action is being blocked by a bank-verification boolean or an unresolved claim state? If we can set a temporary flag in the backend, we can move forward without a full verification.

Sarah — if you approve the placeholder PO approach, reply with the PO amount and the primary contact for routing. We'll aim to have something in place within the same business day.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Manager, Supplier Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, Sarah Cole <sarah@orchidea-supplies.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Manual PO activation still greyed out - Orchidea

FYI — I pulled the activation trace for tenant V-7921 (trace id 9876). The UI is hitting a token-binding check in the claim flow; if the bank_verification_flag is false AND the claimant's session token is an admin-bypass type, our frontend disables the manual PO action to prevent accidental approvals. In this case the vendor profile looks correct but the bank verification webhook callback from our processor never came through earlier this morning (503 timeouts).

Workarounds:
- I can flip the admin-temporary-allow flag for V-7921 (ops change, non-persistent) which will enable the manual PO button. This is safe for one-time use.
- If Ops prefers, I can create a placeholder PO on behalf of procurement in our system (internal only) and email you the PO id; finance teams can use that for matching while the portal remains in Pending.

I attached the trimmed trace log (trace-9876.txt) for the audit. If you want the admin flag change, Laura, please confirm and I'll run the ops script (runbook step: PROC_ADMIN_ALLOW --tenant V-7921 --duration 8h).

—Ben
Platform Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

> > Sarah — thanks for the details and the screenshot. Sorry you're blocked. I copied Ben (platform) and Laura (operations) to help triage.

From: maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Cole <sarah@orchidea-supplies.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-30T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Manual PO activation still greyed out - Orchidea

Sarah — quick update and confirmed next steps.

Summary of fix:
- Ops (Laura) authorised the non-persistent admin allow flag for tenant V-7921. Ben confirmed the manual PO button is now enabled. The underlying bank-verification webhook is still retrying with the processor, but this unblock covers our immediate need.

What we did for you:
1) Created placeholder PO: PO-ORC-20260930-01 for the amount you provided ($12,400). This PO is visible in the procurement portal and can be used for matching and payment routing.
2) Uploaded a copy of the onboarding_form.pdf to our shared Drive folder and linked the PO for your finance team. Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cOrchideaOnboard
3) We set the admin allow flag to auto-expire in 8 hours. Please complete any approvals or uploads before 23:40 PDT today.

Next steps for Orchidea:
- Confirm receipt and whether your AP team needs any additional docs (tax form, signed W-9) attached to PO-ORC-20260930-01.
- If you see any unexpected behavior after we expire the flag, reply and we'll reopen a ticket.

Thanks for your patience — sorry again for the interruption. Laura, Ben — thank you for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Manager, Supplier Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachments: onboarding_form.pdf (shared link), PO-ORC-20260930-01 (system record)
